t: Abel vehaoseqim bammet peturim miqqeriat shema
s: Abel vehaoseqim bammet peturim miqqeriat shema ubo v' seipim: mi shemmet lo met shechayyab lehitabbel alayv, apillu eno muttal alayv leqobro, kegon shemmeta achoto nesua shebbalah chayyab biqburatah, o apillu yesh lo mi sheyyishtaddel bishbilo laasoq betzorke haqqebura, o apillu kebar asaq kol tzerakko — patur miqqeriat shema utepilla umikkol habberakot vaapillu meaniyyat amen umikkol hammitzvot haamurot battora. Vaapillu im rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo veliqrot, o apillu laanot amen sheeno mitbattel bishbilo mitztzorke hammet — asur middibre soperim mippene kebodo shel met, sheyyihyeh libbo panuy lechashsheb betzorke hammet veyachshob bahem tamid. Vaapillu hu beir acheret venoda lo qodem haqqebura — asur, shello chillequ chakamim. Veyesh mattirim im yesh lo mi sheyyitasseq bishbilo, veen tzarik lomar im hu beir acheret sheeno yakol lehitasseq. Venohagin kisbara harishona (uledibre hakkol ben shehu onen al abiv — yakol lelek lebet hakkeneset velomar qaddish al abiv, ki zehu kebodo shel abiv). Vekol zeh qodem haqqebura, abal miyyad shemmatchilin lehashlik apar al hammet — chayyab biqriat shema im lo abar zemannah. Utepillat y"ch bilbaddah yakol lehitpallel apillu achar zemannah shehu shelish hayyom, im lo abar adayin chatzot hayyom. Abal achar kak lo yitpallel mincha shettayim letashlumin shel shacharit, kevan shehaya patur beshacharit. Umittaam zeh lo yomar kol birkot hashshachar, apillu niqbar qodem sheabar zeman qeriat shema utepilla, kevan shebbeshaa shechal chiyyub habberakot dehaynu kesheqqam mimmittato haya patur mehen — en tzarik lehashliman achar kak. Veim mebarek — beraka lebattala hi:

Vekol zeh bechol, abal beshabbat kevan shei epshar laasoq betzorke hammet biqburato veen aninut noheget kelal — chayyab biqriat shema utepilla ubekol hammitzvot haamurot battora kol hayyom. Uleet ereb, im hu machshik al hattechum lehitasseq betzorke haqqebura — patur. Abal im eno machshik al hattechum — chayyab gam leet ereb bekol hammitzvot. Veyesh lo gam ken liqrot qeriat shema shel arbit mibbeod yom ap al pi sheen haqqahal qorin bemotzae shabbat ad hallayla, mikkol maqom zeh sheyyihyeh patur ballayla — lo yebattel mimmennu ol malkut shamayim kol sheyakol liqrot qodem hallayla, shehare rob haqqahal qorin kol yemot hashshabua mibbeod yom, im ken yakol zeh lismok al zeh beoto shabbat. Veen tzarik lomar sheyyesh lo lehitpallel tepillat arbit shel motzae shabbat mibbeod yom mippelag hamincha ulemala, shehu layla gamur leinyan tepilla ler' yehuda. Veap mi shennahag leolam kachakamim — yakol lismok al dibre rabbi yehuda apillu bemotzae shabbat bimqom ezeh ones shei epshar lo lehitpallel ballayla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rtz"g:

Yom tob sheni — dino kechol, shehare yakol leqobro hayyom kemo bechol. Veyom tob rishon im rotzeh leqobro bo bayyom al yede nokrim — dino kechol, shehare tzarik lehamtzi lahem aron vetakrikin. Veim eno rotzeh leqobro bo bayyom — dino kemo beshabbat. Vedin lel yom tob bemaqom sheen qoberin met ballayla, veken bayyom bemaqom shei epshar leqobro mechamat ezeh ones — yitbaer besiman tqm"ch:

Hamshammer et hammet ap al pi sheeno meto — patur miqqeriat shema umittepilla umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, mippene shehu oseq bemitzva, vekol haoseq bemitzva — lo hitrichattu tora litroach bemmitzvot acherot ap al pi sheyyakol, kemo shennitbaer besiman l"ch. Hayu shenayim meshammerim — zeh meshammer vezeh qore, veachar kak meshammer zeh veqore zeh:

Veken hachoper qeber lemet patur mikkullan apillu bishat nucho, kemo sh(yi)[ni]tebbaer sham. Hayu choperim shenayim o yoter kol hatztzerikim letzorke hachapira bebat achat — peturin. Veim yesh nosapin — nishmatin veqorin vechozerin ellu hannosapim umitasseqim, vehaacherim nishmatin kemispar hannosapin veqorin vechozerin lehitasseq, venishmatim acherim ad shennimtza sheqqareu kullam, velo nitbattel shum dabar meeseq haqqeber kelal (apillu rega):

Asur liqrot qeriat shema tok d' ammot shel met o tok d' ammot shel qeber, mishshum "loeg larash cherep osehu". Veim qara — lo yatza, vetzarik lachazor veliqrot, sheqqenasuhu chakamim al sheabar al dibrehem, vaapillu haya shogeg. Ubet haqqebarot hammuqqap mechitztza — muttar liqrot chutz lammechitztza, apillu samuk lah ubetok d' ammot laqqebarot. Abal betok hammechitztza — yesh limnoa apillu chutz led' ammot, shemma yitqareb led' ammot shel ezeh qeber beli daat. Veim qara — yatza, kevan sheeno issur barur ella mishshum chashash lebad:
